name: table-36
description: Rows that can be moved up or down with buttons to set a playlist order.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ArrowDownIcon, ArrowUpIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const initialTracks = [ { id: "t1", title: "Morning Static", artist: "Lumen Drive", length: "3:42" }, { id: "t2", title: "Glass Harbor", artist: "Okra Sun", length: "4:10" }, { id: "t3", title: "Paper Kites", artist: "Velvet Ash", length: "2:58" }, { id: "t4", title: "Night Cycle", artist: "Lumen Drive", length: "5:01" }, ] export default function ReorderableRowsTable() { const [tracks, setTracks] = React.useState(initialTracks) const move = (index: number, dir: -1 | 1) => setTracks((list) => { const next = [...list] const [item] = next.splice(index, 1) next.splice(index + dir, 0, item!) return next }) return (
# Title Length Reorder {tracks.map((track, i) => ( {i + 1}

{track.title}

{track.artist}

 {track.length}
))}
) }
